summary: You proposed a strong reef-monitoring mission with clear Australian benefit and a thorough plan using STK. Your writing is readable with a clear Gantt. Main gap is lack of technical calculations/results to guide the full design, plus referencing and figure presentation to fix.
next_steps: Add orbit, coverage, resolution, link and sizing calculations with STK plots to verify your reef relay concept.
Make contingency explicit in your Project Plan and align your 9-item Useful Links list with in-text citations 1-4.
Number and caption figures/tables including Image 1 Gantt and formalise mission requirements.

criteria.C1: You did well in Mission Concept & Rationale linking near-real-time relay to ground stations and quantifying need e.g. 30% coral loss in 2016. To move higher in Accomplished, formalise mission goals, objectives and requirements with literature support.
criteria.C2: Your Image 1 Gantt and Project Plan & Preliminary Progress link tasks to mission and reserve Week 10 for review. To stay solidly Accomplished, add explicit provision for variations and contingencies beyond the editing buffer and why plan fits mission narrative.
criteria.C3: You completed STK tutorials 1-4 and background reading, showing intent. For Accomplished you need a good preliminary set of results with interpretation - add orbit, coverage, resolution, link or sizing calculations and plots.
criteria.C4: Your report is well-written with headings and readable Gantt. For Accomplished, match in-text refs 1-4 to your Useful Links list with proper citations, and add numbered captions and consistent formatting for figures and tables.
